notes.title: Winter Update - Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Greetings epic fans! Welcome to our first event. The team has been busy working on a number of big updates. First is our new battle map called "SnowForts". This map moves the snails to the ground popping in and out of trenches for the best shot. Second is our "Snowblaster Kit DLC". Ever since 1999 I had wanted to create a multiplayer snowball wargame. Finally 18 years later the Snowblaster has arrived. Epic Snails will remain FREE, our goal is to sell optional kits to pay the team. Thanks for helping us create our little game.


New:
New map Snowfort!Snowblaster DLC Kit Snow SkinSnowblaster Cannon SkinSnow HelmetSquare HeadphonesSki MaskSanta HatReindeer AntlersRound HeadphonesPost match screen will now display which players have left the matchAdded new cosmetic options for face, ear, and shell skinAdded Face, Ears, and Skin filter options in inventory screenNew shop UI featuring more buying optionsAdded some social media buttons to the settings screenEach team will now have a match MVP that will get an extra match end rewardAdded feedback when the game loses connection to the servers (i.e. snails disappearing)
Changes:
The lobby has been decorated for the holidaysUpdated SFX for the assault cannonAssault Cannon and Missile Launcher will now properly respect accuracy damage effectsRebalanced these weapons to account for this changeGraphical fixes in BackyardIncreased the chat scroll sensitivityAll health pickups can now only be picked up if you are hurtImproved score syncing between players. Especially for players that join a match lateBalaclava is now considered a Face item and can be worn with Helmet items
Bugfixes:
Fixed the reload spamming glitchFix for some players not being able to move when coming back to the lobby from a matchFix for chat getting squished while another UI is openFix for super high jump glitchFix for some snails floating and shakingMiscellaneous bug fixes
